text: Men newinani ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen lummbugol maayo noon ɓaawo nde Men udditi mo haa ɓe taƴitiri mo kisal. Fir'awna e konu mun ngun hewti- tori ɓe tooñe e jaggitere, haa nde baharu on uddi- tanii mo, o fuɗɗii yoolagol, o taƴii daɗugol, on wi'i: Mi gomɗinii wonnde alaa reweteeɗo e goonga si wanaa on Mo ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen gomɗini, min ko jeyaaɗo e jebbiloranii ɓe Alla ɓen dewal.
